recent_excerpts: CISA added CVE-2026-65660, a network-exploitable SharePoint code injection flaw, to its KEV catalog with a 2026-09-28 federal remediation deadline.
CISA added CVE-2025-39682, a 9.8-CVSS Linux kernel TLS receive-path flaw, to its KEV catalog after evidence of active exploitation in the wild.
CVE-2025-39964, a race condition in the Linux kernel's AF_ALG socket code, is now in CISA's KEV catalog. Federal agencies must remediate by September 21, 2026.
